prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity CareSync caregiver web app screenshot, landscape 1536x1024, flat edge-to-edge browser content, no mockup frame. Composition C: conversation-led, an assistant-centered command workspace. Very different layout from overview grid or chronological timeline. Keep selected community care wayfinding identity: deep plum #342449, pale lavender #EEE9F6, white #FFFFFF, very light cool gray #F7F8FA, ink #292333. Friendly Segoe-like sans with excellent hierarchy, line icons, practical 12px radii. No gradients or glow, no photography or human illustration, no fake metrics.
STRUCTURE: narrow 80px deep plum left icon navigation rail: linked-loop mark at top, home selected, medication, calendar, supplies, memory icons, Maya initials at bottom. Next a 280px light household rail: title 'Elena’s care', ER initials avatar Elena Reyes, 78 · Austin. Slim white care groups without nested cards: 'Medications' rows Aspirin 81 mg Taken, Lisinopril 10 mg Missed, Metformin 500 mg Upcoming. 'Next visit' Thursday, 2:00 PM, Cardiology, Dr. Anita Patel, 'Prepare visit' text action. 'Supplies' Northstar Overnight, 4 days left, Review reorder. Kitchen Echo Show · Online at bottom.
REMAINING MAIN: top white bar 'Care assistant' with Alexa+ simulator badge right and Voice on. Broad pale lavender conversation working surface fills remaining viewport. At top unobtrusive 'Today' divider. Large comfortable readable conversation, plenty of space, 700px max text width. User bubble right with MR avatar: 'What’s going on with Mom today?' Assistant left linked ring mark, title CareSync and reply 'Elena missed her morning Lisinopril. Her cardiology visit is Thursday at 2 PM, and there are 4 days of briefs left.' Beneath reply three horizontal specific response rows 'Morning dose / Lisinopril · 10 mg / Missed', 'Next visit / Thursday, 2:00 PM / Maya driving', 'Supply runway / Northstar Overnight / 4 days left'. Then next user bubble 'Remind her on the kitchen Show'. Assistant reply 'I can send a reminder to Elena’s kitchen Echo Show. Send it?' A well-crafted white confirmation slip with thin muted purple border: title 'Send a medication reminder?', body 'Kitchen Echo Show · Lisinopril 10 mg', supporting 'This sends a reminder. It does not mark the dose as taken.' strong plum 'Yes, send it' and neutral 'Not now' buttons side by side. Clear 'Awaiting your confirmation' status with small clock icon.
BOTTOM: anchored prominent wide white input 'Ask about Elena’s care…' with microphone and plum send arrow. Below input muted note 'Actions need your confirmation. Orders are simulated.' and small 'Reset household' at far right. Tiny bottom 'Simulated household. Not a medical device.'
The screen should feel complete, tangible, highly polished and buildable, excellent aligned spacing, unambiguous confirmation, care context remains visible beside conversation. No tile grid as main canvas, no fake dates, no fabricated logos, no English spelling errors.
approval: User selected C and authorized implementation and supporting backend changes on 2026-10-19.
notes: Use live household data in implementation. Omit invented calendar dates and routine outcomes. Generic illustrative supply and device cutouts reproduce the selected comp; no real brand or product claims.
